description: ACCTMNT: ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE
APPLIES THE BRANCHES' MAINTENANCE REQUESTS TO THE MASTER AT
THE END OF THE DAY: OPENS ACCOUNTS, CLOSES THEM, FREEZES AND
UNFREEZES THEM, AND CHANGES OVERDRAFT LIMITS. THE REQUESTS
COME IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER AND ARE MATCHED AGAINST THE
MASTER: EACH ACCOUNT IS HELD WHILE ITS REQUESTS APPLY, THEN
WRITTEN TO THE NEW MASTER. A REQUEST THAT CANNOT APPLY GOES TO
THE REJECTS WITH ITS REASON.
RULES: AN OPENING NEEDS AN ACCOUNT NUMBER NOT YET USED; ANY
OTHER REQUEST AN ACCOUNT THAT EXISTS AND IS NOT CLOSED. ONLY
AN EMPTY ACCOUNT CLOSES. ONLY AN OPEN ACCOUNT FREEZES, ONLY A
FROZEN ONE UNFREEZES. ONLY CURRENT ACCOUNTS HAVE OVERDRAFTS.
MAINTENANCE NEVER MOVES MONEY: THE NEW MASTER MUST HOLD THE
SAME BALANCES AS THE OLD.
RETURN CODES: 0 ALL APPLIED, 4 SOME REJECTED,
16 INPUT OUT OF ORDER, OUT OF BALANCE OR I/O.
MODIFICATION HISTORY
DATE       BY  CHANGE
1988-05-09 JA  CR-0031 ORIGINAL VERSION.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

LEFT AS IS, WINDOWED ON READ: BELOW 50 IS 20YY.

REJECT.

identification.text: FIRST BANK OF PANGAEA, DATA CENTER.

records.name: BANK-CONTROL-RECORD
records.description: BANKCTL: BANK CONTROL RECORD, ONE PER FILE THE BUSINESS DATE THE BATCH RUNS FOR, NEVER THE CLOCK.

records.name: MAINT-REQUEST
records.description: MAINTREC: ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE REQUEST, 80 BYTES THE BRANCHES' REQUESTS TO OPEN AN ACCOUNT, CLOSE ONE, FREEZE OR UNFREEZE ONE, OR CHANGE ITS OVERDRAFT LIMIT, IN ACCOUNT NUMBER AND REQUEST ID ORDER. AN OPENING CARRIES THE NEW ACCOUNT'S CUSTOMER, NAME AND TYPE; A LIMIT CHANGE THE NEW LIMIT. THE EFFECTIVE DATE IS THE DAY THE BRANCH TOOK THE REQUEST, YYMMDD. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1988-05-09 JA  CR-0031 ORIGINAL VERSION. 1991-10-07 PK  CR-0129 EFFECTIVE DATE OF THE REQUEST. 1999-01-11 SL  Y2K: LEFT AS IS, WINDOWED ON READ.

records.name: WS-MASTER-KEY
records.description: MATCH KEYS: HIGH-VALUES ONCE A FILE IS AT ITS END. THE ACTIVE KEY IS THE LOWER OF THE TWO: THE ACCOUNT BEING WORKED ON.

records.name: WS-HELD-SW
records.description: THE ACCOUNT HELD WHILE ITS REQUESTS APPLY.

records.name: ACCT-MASTER-RECORD
records.description: ACCTMAST: ACCOUNT MASTER RECORD, 100 BYTES IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER. THE BALANCE MAY GO BELOW ZERO DOWN TO THE OVERDRAFT LIMIT, AND BELOW THAT ONLY BY FEES. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1994-11-14 PK  CR-0201 OVERDRAFT LIMIT, FROM THE FILLER. 1999-01-11 SL  Y2K: 8-DIGIT DATES.

records.name: REJECT-RECORD
records.description: REJREC: REJECTED TRANSACTION, 110 BYTES THE TRANSACTION AS RECEIVED, WITH THE STEP THAT REJECTED IT AND WHY. ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE REJECTS ITS REQUESTS IN THE SAME FORM, THE REQUEST IN PLACE OF THE TRANSACTION. THE DATE IT WAS REJECTED IS TEXT, YYYY-MM-DD, AS THE BRANCHES READ IT. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1988-05-09 JA  CR-0031 ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE REASONS. 2009-03-02 MV  CR-0444 THE DATE OF THE REJECTION. RECORD WIDENED TO 110 BYTES.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.description: MATCH UNTIL BOTH FILES END, THEN RECONCILE AND REPORT.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.description: OPEN THE FILES AND READ THE FIRST RECORD OF EACH.

paragraphs.name: 1200-READ-MASTER
paragraphs.description: READ THE NEXT OLD MASTER RECORD, CHECKING ACCOUNT ORDER.

paragraphs.name: 1300-READ-REQUEST
paragraphs.description: READ THE NEXT REQUEST, CHECKING ITS ORDER.

paragraphs.name: 2000-NEXT-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.description: TAKE THE LOWER KEY AS THE ACTIVE ACCOUNT, AND HOLD IT IF THE MASTER HAS IT. AN ACCOUNT ONLY THE REQUESTS NAME IS NOT HELD UNTIL AN OPENING MAKES IT.

paragraphs.name: 2100-APPLY-REQUESTS
paragraphs.description: APPLY THE ACTIVE ACCOUNT'S REQUESTS, ONE AFTER THE OTHER.

paragraphs.name: 2200-APPLY-REQUEST
paragraphs.description: APPLY ONE REQUEST BY ITS TYPE.

paragraphs.name: 2210-OPEN
paragraphs.description: OPEN A NEW ACCOUNT, EMPTY, FROM THE REQUEST'S EFFECTIVE DATE.

paragraphs.name: 2220-CLOSE
paragraphs.description: CLOSE AN ACCOUNT, IF IT IS EMPTY.

paragraphs.name: 2250-LIMIT
paragraphs.description: CHANGE A CURRENT ACCOUNT'S OVERDRAFT LIMIT.

paragraphs.name: 2290-REJECT
paragraphs.description: WRITE THE REQUEST TO THE REJECTS WITH ITS REASON.

paragraphs.name: 2800-WRITE-HELD
paragraphs.description: WRITE THE HELD ACCOUNT, ITS REQUESTS APPLIED, TO THE NEW MASTER.

paragraphs.name: 9900-ABORT
paragraphs.description: STOP THE RUN WITH RETURN CODE 16, SAYING WHY.
